signaling_summary: Digital TTL-compatible signaling on SCK / WS / SD. Input threshold levels: VH = 2.0 V (HIGH), VL = 0.8 V (LOW). Although the protocol is purely digital, I2S is the data-bus interface to A/D and D/A audio converters — the analog characteristics of those converters (sample rate, dynamic range, SNR) are separate from the I2S protocol itself.
